title: Unknown publisher — three unlabelled Host/Port rows without appendix (held-out pilot)

provenance.method: constructed: three Host/Port table rows without a publisher IOC appendix heading. Under section_tree these must not become document-global MODE A Indicators. Fixture title intentionally avoids the token IOC so the case measures unlabelled-row authority, not heading over-match (the IOC-shaped H1 defect is covered by reliabilityObservability regression).
provenance.coverage_note: Synthetic held-out case pinning section-tree authority behaviour on unlabelled rows. Original pilot H1 containing 'IOC-shaped' was promoted to regression after it drove a general heading fix.
